location_exception_reason: PEB services are nationwide industrial infrastructure solutions; location in title is redundant (buyer filters by service capability, not geography). GI-tagged or regional-origin exception does not apply.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words ('Manufacturer', 'EPC Contractor', 'Supplier', 'Turnkey Provider') materially change buyer expectations: Manufacturer = in-house fabrication capability; EPC = design+build responsibility; Turnkey = full erection included; Supply-only = buyer arranges erection. Removing the type word leaves the service scope ambiguous.
